title: KYY K1302R Portable Monitor Review An Inexpensive Travel Display
author: Sam Sabinash

KYY K1302R Portable Monitor With Box 1
The KYY K1302R is a 15.6-inch portable monitor with a 1920×1080 IPS panel, 60Hz refresh rate, dual USB Type-C inputs, and a mini HDMI input. It has an upgraded, integrated kickstand that houses all the ports and built-in speakers. The KYY K1302R jumps right into the market for inexpensive portable monitors and compares favorably with many we have tested.
Here is the Amazon affiliate link to where we purchased this unit.
KYY K1302R Hardware Overview
The KYY K1302R is a 15.6-inch 16:9 IPS monitor with a Full HD 1920×1080 resolution. It supports a 65-degree forward and back tilt as well as 90-degree left and right rotation, 60Hz refresh rate, and 1200:1 typical contrast.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor Front 3
Around the back, this is a different design from the KYY K1302R. Unlike any portable monitor we tested to date, the K1302R has all the ports integrated on the stand.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor Rear 1
Here is a look at the stand from the side. The stand itself makes the monitor operable for horizontal and vertical viewing. The monitor dimensions without the stand are 14.8in x 8.77in x 0.23in, with a listed weight of 2.93lb.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor Rear Angled 1
For display inputs, the KYY K1302R has two USB Type-C ports.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor USB Type C Ports 1
There is also a mini HDMI input.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor Mini HDMI Port 1
On the bottom of the stand, KYY includes a 3.5mm audio jack.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor 3.5mm Audio Jack 1
The monitor also has built in speakers.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor Built In Speakers 1
Controls are split between four buttons on the rear of the stand.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor Stand 1
A USB Type-C cable is included in the box.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor USB Type C To USB Type C Cable 1
There is also a mini HDMI to HDMI.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor HDMI To Mini HDMI Cable 1
Lastly, there is is a USB Type-A to USB Type-C cable.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor USB Type A To USB Type C Cable 1
Here is the monitor with its retail box.
KYY K1302R Portable Monitor With Box 1
